title: Make all golden scenarios run on a single long-lived server
description: Currently the xmage_server fixture in conftest.py is session-scoped, so all golden tests in a single pytest session share one server. However if golden tests are split into separate files (see split-golden-test-files issue), each file would get its own server startup, which is slow. Ensure that all golden test files share a single long-lived XMage server across the entire test session, regardless of how many test files there are. This may require a conftest.py at the tests/ level with a session-scoped fixture, or a pytest plugin.
